mappings.note: Translation v1 is a title/intro ('Cantique. Psaume des enfants de Coré') which corresponds to the header of OSMAIN v1 but contains no verse text itself. In OSMAIN, this content is part of v1's text.
Translation v2 covers the first half of OSMAIN v1 ('L'Éternel est grand... sur sa montagne sainte'). The second half of OSMAIN v1 is missing here.
Matches OSMAIN v2 content ('Skjønt å se... den store Kongens by').
Matches OSMAIN v3 content ('Gud har gjort seg kjent...'). Note: Translation uses 'haute retraite' (high refuge) vs OSMAIN 'sikker tilflukt' (secure refuge), but semantic match is exact.
Matches OSMAIN v4 content ('For se, kongene samlet seg...').

Translation v6 covers the reaction part of OSMAIN v5 ('De så – da ble de slått av undring... flyktet i hast'). The 'L'ont-ils vue?' (Did they see it?) is a rhetorical addition in French, but the core content matches.
Matches OSMAIN v6 content ('Skjelving grep dem der...').
Matches OSMAIN v7 content ('Med østavinden knuser du Tarsis-skipene').
Matches OSMAIN v8 content ('Som vi har hørt... Sela').

Translation says 'nous avons attendu ta faveur' (we have waited for your favor). OSMAIN v9 says 'Vi har fordypet oss i din trofaste kjærlighet' (We have meditated on/thought deeply about your faithful love). The verb 'waited/expected' is not in the source text; it implies a different action than 'meditating'. This is an extra content interpretation.
Matches OSMAIN v10 content ('Som ditt navn...').
Matches OSMAIN v11 content ('Sion-fjellet skal glede seg...').
Matches OSMAIN v12 content ('Gå rundt Sion og vandre omkring det, tell dets tårn').
Matches OSMAIN v13 content ('Legg merke til dens voller...').
Matches OSMAIN v14 content ('For denne Gud er vår Gud...').

extraContent.description: The phrase 'nous avons attendu ta faveur' (we have waited for your favor) in Translation v10 does not match the OSMAIN text 'Vi har fordypet oss i din trofaste kjærlighet' (We have meditated on/thought deeply about your faithful love). The concept of 'waiting/expecting' is an addition not present in the source.
